hero.title: Expert Heart Care in the Heart of Cairo
hero.subtitle: Since 2009, {clinic} has combined decades of clinical excellence with state-of-the-art imaging to deliver comprehensive cardiology and internal medicine care.

about.label: About The Clinic
about.title: Fifteen years of trusted cardiac care in Nasr City
about.p1: Founded in 2009, {clinic} began as a small consultation practice and has grown into one of the most respected private cardiology clinics in Cairo.
about.p2: Today, our team of {doctors} specialists sees over {patients} patients each year — combining international standards of care with the personal touch of a neighborhood clinic.
about.excellenceText: Internationally trained specialists using current clinical protocols.
about.transparencyText: Clear fees, transparent deposit model, ETA e-receipts on every payment.
about.continuityText: Every patient sees the same consultant for follow-up visits and care.
about.accessibilityText: WhatsApp-first communication, Fawry and Vodafone Cash payment options.

steps.label: How Booking Works
steps.title: Four steps. No account required.
steps.s1d: Browse our specialists and pick the right expert for your visit.
steps.s2d: Pick your date and time in seconds — no account required.
steps.s3d: Confirm with a small deposit via Card, Fawry, or Vodafone Cash.
steps.s4d: We'll message you 48h and 2h before your visit.

cta.title: Ready to book your visit?
cta.subtitle: Choose your specialist, pick a time that works, and secure your slot with a small deposit. No account required.
